statements.select:
SELECT C.CUST_CD, C.CUST_CD2, C.CUST_NM, C.DMOS_CD, DBO.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#,'DMOS_CD',C.DMOS_CD) AS DMOS_NM, C.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM, C.USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS USER_NM, C.NAT_CD, C.CUST_GRADE, DBO.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#,'CUST_GRADE',C.CUST_GRADE) AS CUST_GRADE_NAME, C.USE_YN, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,S.SA_SDATE),23) AS SA_SDATE, C.TRMS_PAY, DBO.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#,'TRMS_PAY',C.TRMS_PAY) AS TRMS_PAY_NAME FROM T_CUSTOMER AS C LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON C.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND C.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON C.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND C.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT CUST_CD, MAX(SA_SDATE) AS SA_SDATE FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY GROUP BY CUST_CD ) AS S ON C.CUST_CD = S.CUST_CD WHERE C.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND C.CUST_CD IS NOT NULL
AND C.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND C.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND C.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND C.CUST_TYPE = #cust_type#
AND C.DMOS_CD = #dmos_cd#
AND C.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
AND C.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%'
AND C.NAT_CD = #nat_cd#
AND C.USE_YN = #use_yn#
AND C.CUST_GRADE = #cust_grade#
AND C.TRMS_PAY = #trms_pay#
ORDER BY C.CUST_NM

SELECT CUST_CD ,CUST_CD2 ,CUST_NM ,CUST_ENG_NM ,CUST_SHT_NM ,USER_CD ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(USER_CD) AS USER_NM ,DEPT_CD ,DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM ,DMOS_CD ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DMOS_CD',DMOS_CD) AS DMOS_NM ,NAT_CD ,BASE_CRNY ,CUST_TYPE ,CUST_GRP ,CUST_LEVEL1 ,CUST_LEVEL2 ,CUST_LEVEL3 ,CUST_CEO ,CUST_NO ,CUST_CTGR ,CUST_ITEM ,CUST_GRADE ,HOME_PAGE ,TEL_NUM ,ZIP_CODE ,ADDRESS_L ,ADDRESS_M ,ADDRESS_S ,ADDRESS_D ,ADDRESS_ALL ,USE_YN ,BCUST_CD ,DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(BCUST_CD) AS BCUST_NM ,TRMS_PAY ,CUST_SEQ FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_CD = #cust_cd#

SELECT K.KM_CD, K.KM_NM, K.KM_USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS KM_USER_NM, K.KM_DEPT_NM, K.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, K.KM_EMAIL, K.M_PHONE, K.USE_YN, k.KM_TITLE FROM T_KEYMAN AS K LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER AS C ON K.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND K.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON K.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND K.KM_USER_CD = U.USER_CD WHERE K.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND K.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#

SELECT S.SA_CD, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,S.SA_SDATE,23),23) AS SA_SDATE, ( CASE WHEN K.KM_CNT > 1 THEN K2.KM_NM + ' 외 ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,K.KM_CNT) + '명' ELSE K2.KM_NM END ) KM_NM, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, ( CASE WHEN P.TARGET_CNT > 1 THEN C.CODE_NM + ' 외 ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.TARGET_CNT) + '건' ELSE C.CODE_NM END ) SA_TARGET, S.SA_BODY, S.SA_COMMENT, S.DEPT_CD FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, SA_CD, MIN(KM_CD) AS KM_CD, COUNT(KM_CD) AS KM_CNT FROM T_SA_KEYMAN GROUP BY COMPANY_CD, SA_CD ) AS K ON S.COMPANY_CD = K.COMPANY_CD AND S.SA_CD = K.SA_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_KEYMAN AS K2 ON K.COMPANY_CD = K2.COMPANY_CD AND K.KM_CD = K2.KM_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, SA_CD, MIN(SA_TARGET) SA_TARGET, COUNT(SA_TARGET) TARGET_CNT FROM T_SA_TARGET GROUP BY COMPANY_CD, SA_CD ) AS P ON S.COMPANY_CD = P.COMPANY_CD AND S.SA_CD = P.SA_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CODE C ON P.SA_TARGET = C.CODE_ID WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND S.CUST_CD = #cust_cd# AND (CAST(S.SA_BODY AS NVARCHAR) != '' AND S.SA_BODY IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY S.SA_SDATE DESC

SELECT P.PJT_CD, P.PJT_NM, P.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, P.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, P.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, P.DSTR_TYPE, P.EUSR_CD, C2.CUST_NM AS EUSR_NM, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(P.PJT_SDATE,'') != '' OR ISNULL(P.PJT_EDATE,'') != '' THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,PJT_SDATE),23) + ' ~ ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,PJT_EDATE),23) ELSE NULL END ) AS PJT_DATE, P.END_YN FROM T_PROJECT AS P LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER AS C ON P.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND P.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER AS C2 ON P.COMPANY_CD = C2.COMPANY_CD AND P.EUSR_CD = C2.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON P.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND P.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON P.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND P.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE P.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND P.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
ORDER BY P.PJT_CD ASC

SELECT A.COMPANY_CD, A.EMAIL_CD, A.EMAIL_DT, A.EMAIL_TYPE, CD.CODE_KOR AS EMAIL_TYPE_NM, A.USER_CD, A.USER_NM + '(' + A.USER_CD + ')' AS USER_NM, A.KM_CD, A.KM_NM + '(' + A.KM_CD + ')' AS KM_NM, SUBJECT FROM( SELECT E.COMPANY_CD, E.EMAIL_CD, E.EMAIL_TYPE, E.EMAIL_DT, E.RCV_USR AS USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS USER_NM, E.SND_USR AS KM_CD, K.KM_NM AS KM_NM, SUBJECT FROM (SELECT COMPANY_CD,EMAIL_CD,EMAIL_TYPE,EMAIL_DT,SND_USR,RCV_USR,SUBJECT FROM T_EMAIL WHERE EMAIL_TYPE = 'RCV') AS E, (SELECT COMPANY_CD,KM_CD,KM_NM,KM_EMAIL FROM T_KEYMAN WHERE CUST_CD = #cust_cd#)AS K, T_USER AS U WHERE E.COMPANY_CD = K.COMPANY_CD AND E.SND_USR = K.KM_EMAIL AND E.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND E.RCV_USR = U.EMAIL UNION SELECT E.COMPANY_CD, E.EMAIL_CD, E.EMAIL_TYPE, E.EMAIL_DT, E.SND_USR AS USER_CD, U.USER_NM AS USER_NM, E.RCV_USR AS KM_CD, K.KM_NM AS KM_NM, SUBJECT FROM (SELECT COMPANY_CD,EMAIL_CD,EMAIL_TYPE,EMAIL_DT,SND_USR,RCV_USR,SUBJECT FROM T_EMAIL WHERE EMAIL_TYPE = 'SND') AS E, (SELECT COMPANY_CD,KM_CD,KM_NM,KM_EMAIL FROM T_KEYMAN WHERE CUST_CD = #cust_cd#)AS K, T_USER AS U WHERE E.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND E.SND_USR = U.EMAIL AND E.COMPANY_CD = K.COMPANY_CD AND E.RCV_USR = K.KM_EMAIL ) AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID,CODE_KOR FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'EMAIL_TYPE') AS CD ON A.EMAIL_TYPE = CD.CODE_ID ORDER BY EMAIL_DT DESC

SELECT COMPANY_CD, EMAIL_CD, EMAIL_TYPE, EMAIL_DT, SND_USR, (CASE WHEN EMAIL_TYPE = 'SND' THEN dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(dbo.FN_GET_USER_CD_TO_EMAIL(SND_USR)) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_KEYMAN_NM(dbo.FN_GET_KM_CD_TO_EMAIL(SND_USR)) END) AS SND_USER_NM, RCV_USR, (CASE WHEN EMAIL_TYPE = 'RCV' THEN dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(dbo.FN_GET_USER_CD_TO_EMAIL(RCV_USR)) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_KEYMAN_NM(dbo.FN_GET_KM_CD_TO_EMAIL(RCV_USR)) END) AS RCV_USER_NM, SUBJECT, CONTENTS FROM T_EMAIL WHERE EMAIL_CD = #email_cd#
statements.update: UPDATE T_CUSTOMER SET MOD_DT = getdate() ,MOD_USR = #mod_usr# ,USER_CD = #user_cd# ,DEPT_CD = #dept_cd# ,NAT_CD = #nat_cd# ,BASE_CRNY = #base_crncy# ,CUST_GRADE = #cust_grade# ,HOME_PAGE = #home_page# ,TRMS_PAY = #trms_pay# ,USE_YN = #use_yn# WHERE CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
